# Move-priority metadata

`move-priority.json` contains only move names, priority numbers and target categories extracted from `data/moves.ts` at Pokémon Showdown commit `a5df8274e85b0889bf2a9b3422a08b39732374fc` (2026-09-29).

Source: https://github.com/smogon/pokemon-showdown/blob/a5df8274e85b0889bf2a9b3422a08b39732374fc/data/moves.ts

The upstream MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`. Metadata is data only; no downloaded TypeScript is executed. Damage calculations continue to use NCP's Champions engine. The initiative adapter adds conditional priority and compares the NCP-computed effective speeds. It is tested separately from damage.
